name: fig20_bell_and_product_entropies
caption: (a) Single-qubit entropy of cos(t)|00> + sin(t)|11>: zero for the product state, ln 2 for the Bell state, while the global entropy is zero throughout. (b) Product state: all quantities vanish. Bell state: S(AB) = 0, S(A) = ln 2, I = 2 ln 2, N = 1/2. Classically correlated mixture: I = ln 2 but N = 0 (correlation without entanglement). Werner state p = 0.5: mixed, entangled.
